split: D13.14 split into completion fence (a) and actual physical worker composition (b); other task IDs preserved.
runtime: Inactive opt-in adapter; configured application remains PostgreSQL.
assertions: Registry version/gate locks precede job and delivery locks.
Actual native index must have expected full ordered columns, BTREE type, visibility and nonunique shape.
Persisted job and tenant/table mappings determine the expectation; caller columns cannot replace them.
Job/audit/delivery changes commit together; missing/stale/foreign/expired/audit-failing cases roll back.
Observed registry lock wait followed by publication version change rejects stale completion.
limitations: Fixture uses privileged physical table/index creation and registry token setup; real DDL intent execution and publication composition remain D13.14b.
Native search indexes only; text, navigation and repair strategies are not claimed by this adapter.
Guard is opt-in and not selected by configured runtime.
Other D13-D20 provider, policy, performance and acceptance gates remain open.
cleanup: Complete: decision-cycle2-runner, decision-cycle2-mysql-1 and decision-cycle2_default removed. MySQL data was disposable tmpfs; no application database was changed.
